{{Quote|On many occasions, K'lial and Diskio are assigned as backup on operations where there is a significant chance that an operative will be apprehended by local authorities. One such operation was the infiltration of the TGM corporate headquarters on Pako Ramoon (see Rebel agent Kara Via's report).|Personal addendum by General Airen Cracken to an entry of a datafile detailing Rebel Alliance operatives dedicated to K'lial and Diskio Khzrry|<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>}}
The '''TGM corporate headquarters''' were maintained by<ref name="CRO" /> [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]]<ref name="Abduction">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures|story=The Abduction|stext=The Abduction of Crying Dawn Singer}}</ref> on the celestial body [[Pako Ramoon]].<ref name="CRO" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The TGM corporate headquarters were created by [[Chuck Truett]] and were introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" />
